record.title: Slovak hauliers obstruct freight at Vyšné Nemecké–Uzhhorod, 1–4 December 2023
record.scope: Intentional throttling of freight access at one international road crossing
record.crossings: Vyšné Nemecké–Uzhhorod road crossing and its Slovak approach
record.direction: Freight access at the crossing; evidence particularly documents Slovak-side queues toward Ukraine, not identical restriction in both directions
record.movement: Ordinary commercial trucks, prominently on the route into Ukraine; not all passenger movement
record.exceptions: Four ordinary trucks per hour reportedly admitted; humanitarian and military consignments, fuel, live animals and fresh/refrigerated goods exempt. Passenger cars and buses unaffected.
record.imposing_authority: Union of Road Hauliers of Slovakia (UNAS), a non-state protest organisation
record.enforcement: Physical protest blockade reported from 15:00 Slovak local time on 1 December and observed on its second day; Ukrainian border service confirms processing restored after blockade ended on 4 December.
record.consequences: Field report describes substantial queues. The next morning’s 625 waiting trucks are a stock, not a causal estimate of trucks newly delayed by this blockade.
record.relationship: Distinct Slovak crossing and organisers from R3-EU-004 Polish carrier blockade. Do not combine separate November and 11–14 December Slovak recurrences.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.official_rationale: Organisers demanded reinstatement of permits for Ukrainian hauliers, citing competition and protection of their transport market.
record.context: Separate Slovak protest alongside Polish carrier blockades. Earlier November and later December recurrences are not merged into this interval.
record.uncertainty: Partial controlled throughput continued during the blockade. The endpoint report gives 22:00 without an explicit timezone; no exact hour-duration computed. Related recurrences are separate leads.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated actual reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. Date interval applies to the partial freight obstruction only. Start reported 15:00 local; endpoint 22:00 timezone not explicit.
